## WasmHostPlatform.lockTrustManifest() method

Acquire exclusive access to the trust manifest at the supplied lock path. Return a synchronous release function. Hosts sharing a config directory must use the same interprocess protocol. The default Node host coordinates with both CLIs and the TypeScript SDK.

**Signature:**

```typescript
lockTrustManifest?(lockPath: string): Promise<() => void>;
```

## Remarks

A host without this capability cannot publish new trust approvals.
